description: List CRM objects of one type (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, or another object type), with paging and optional properties.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's response, to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return in one page.

objectType.description: The CRM object type to list, such as contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

properties.description: Names of the properties to return for each listed object.

name: hubspot_list_objects
